description: First product-surface demonstration of mal-fabric: canonical geometric programs are rendered and manipulated through confluent text and visual surfaces, governed before commitment, and synchronously executed with visible runtime custody. Includes the promoted V3.1 static, V3.2 admission, and V3.3 execution substrates; the DEMO-001 browser surface; a deterministic proposer with no commit authority; and 18/18 acceptance evidence.
title: MaL Fabric v0.4.0: Visible Canonical Geometric Programming
